new_results.statement: For commuting symmetric A0,C, with B=A0+C and d_j the decreasing rearrangement of (lambda_j(A0)^2-lambda_j(B)^2)_+ in their common eigenbasis, lambda_k((B^2)[H,H]) >= lambda_{k+p}((A0^2)[H,H])-d_{p+1}. After arbitrary symmetric rank-r L and ||T||op<=delta, sqrt(lambda_k((A^2)[H,H])) >= [max_p sqrt((lambda_{k+r+p}((A0^2)[H,H])-d_{p+1})_+) - delta]_+. Absolute-magnitude-increasing commuting eigenvalue replacements are exactly free, regardless of sign/magnitude.

For a valid grouped projected-crossing certificate, invertible M_J -> T0 M_J leaves row(M_J), Pi, projected crossing C, Z_ell and row marginals unchanged and changes S by |det T0|. Arbitrary internal hub/light blocks, hub-to-I updates in the hub frame, and I-J updates annihilated by I-Pi are magnitude-free. If |det T0|>=1 the density bound does not worsen.

actual_partner_application.family: 16-dimensional Walsh-Hadamard baseline with eight +2 and eight -2 eigenvalues; all 16 replaced with at most two ending at magnitude <2; arbitrary unbounded symmetric rank-one packet; dense tail ||T||op<=1/4

projected_crossing_application.family: 7 physical coordinates, k=2, ell=1, M_J=[e1^T;e2^T], one diffuse projected crossing direction, arbitrary internal same-bank blocks, M_J transformed by any T0 with sigma_min(T0)>=1
derived_inequalities: density has a continuous C0 representative in this scope

unresolved_implication: From bare s3(A)>=1, force either a six-mode original-coordinate spectral-square carrier or a grouped projected-crossing split with quantitative S, Z_ell and row-marginal gates, or route failure to an already-paid D5/ridge/physical-pair/core/half-Riesz/grouped-bank/Schur exit. Arbitrary noncommuting full-rank spectral changes remain outside the new magnitude-free compiler.
next_step: Use the exact projected-crossing gauge invariance to normalize a surviving low-rank/concentrated-volume chamber from the newest fleet structural reductions, and test whether its hostile residual lies entirely in row(M_J) or creates a quantitatively diffuse projected component.
